unlisted_practices: Tiered optimization strategy for medical LLMs (prompt engineering, knowledge-augmented retrieval, hybrid neuro-symbolic architectures, causal reasoning frameworks)

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical benchmark evaluation and granular error analysis (assessing omissions, hallucinations, safety, and robustness) of 10 Chinese medical LLMs on MedBench, but does not test a specific deployed organizational safeguard.
